title: The rubric requires a GL 6200 Legal/Audit expense balance of 870,569.38, but that figure is exactly double the true balance (435,284.69) because the source dump's total row double-counts its own subtotal, so an agent that reconciles to the TB is penalized.
evidence: Legal_Dump-1.xlsx: L60=SUM(L3:L59), then L62=SUM(L3:L61), which includes L60 (likewise M62 includes M60); L63=870,569.38. Aurisic_Final_TB_4-25-1.txt: 0010-6200 YTD = 435,284.69. Answer key #10 V63=870,569.38. Rubric: 'cumulative net debit balance of 870,569.38'.
confirmation: Legal_Dump-1.xlsx L62 '=SUM(L3:L61)' re-adds the L60 subtotal (M62 likewise), so L63 = 870,569.38, exactly twice the TB 0010-6200 YTD of 435,284.69; the rubric item requires 870,569.38, rewarding the double count and penalizing the correct balance.
